headline: Davis Cup Final 8 in Bologna: Czechia through; Italy vs Korea still open after Musetti
whyCareReason: Three-time defending champions Italy host South Korea in Bologna after Czechia booked the first semifinal, with Great Britain vs Germany on Thursday.
teaser: Czechia sweep Canada 2-0. Lorenzo Musetti beats Seongchan Hong 6-0, 7-6(5); Flavio Cobolli vs Soonwoo Kwon unpublished as final. Thursday: GB vs Germany.
story:
The 2026 Davis Cup Final 8 knockout stage is underway at SuperTennis Arena (BolognaFiere).

On Tuesday, Czechia became the first nation into the semifinals by beating Canada 2-0, Tomas Machac defeating Liam Draxl 6-2, 3-6, 6-2 and Jiri Lehecka beating Felix Auger-Aliassime 7-6(4), 6-2.

On Wednesday, Lorenzo Musetti gave Italy the opening rubber against South Korea, 6-0, 7-6(5) over Seongchan Hong. The tie remains open: official Davis Cup lists Italy vs Korea in progress, so Flavio Cobolli vs Soonwoo Kwon is unpublished as a final. Thursday quarterfinals: Great Britain vs Germany at 10:00 CET, Austria vs Spain at 17:00 CET.
stakes: A semifinal berth against the remaining Final 8 field awaits the winner as Italy chase a historic fourth consecutive Davis Cup crown.
rivalryAngle: Italy open their home title defense backed by noisy Bologna support, with Musetti and Cobolli leading the singles charge.
funFacts: Musetti took the first set 6-0 then the second-set tiebreak 7-6(5).
Czechia swept Canada 2-0 on Tuesday to become the first team into the semifinals.
Great Britain vs Germany opens Thursday at 10:00 CET, followed by Austria vs Spain.
